limitations: Instruction and call counts are static whole-function counts including setup and cold failure paths; they do not measure hot execution counts or prove causality.
A missing LLVM function symbol can result from inlining, elimination or linking; it is not evidence of zero executed work.
Old CPU captures were throttled, contain only hundreds of samples and are exploratory hotspot hints, not coverage measurements or a fresh profile.

Disassembly was inspected from binaries whose hashes match the baseline. Cache IL was matched by manifest digest/name but is supporting evidence, not an independent proof of compiler-source equivalence.
reproduce_static_inspection: Read functions in .mylang-cache/runtime-expanded/runner/mycache/modules/*/out/main.manifest.json; find il_digest in frontend/fragments/*/il/*; run objdump -d --no-show-raw-insn --disassemble=<symbol> on runner/bin/<group>-<arm> after checking its baseline SHA256.
